t: What Optics and Photonics Database Is All About
title: What Optics and Photonics Database Is All About
description: Optics is light manipulated: lenses bend it, lasers concentrate it, fibers guide it. A laser's stimulated emission produces coherent light — same wavelength, same phase — enabling everything from barcode scanners to fusion ignition. Fiber optics carry the internet: a hair-thin glass strand guides terabits per second by total internal reflection, with losses under 0.2 dB/km. This database is the complete optical system: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Optics and Photonics Database: a complete reference database of full optical system records.
key_points: What this database holds: full optical system records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
